title: Shroom Shorts
about: A sample channel for clips of your own mushroom-farm videos. Rename or delete it.
niche: Mushroom growing for curious beginners and small growers: grow rooms, substrate, harvests, mistakes and wins.
lookFor: a visual moment: a flush, a pin set, a harvest
one practical growing tip with a clear takeaway
a mistake and what fixed it
avoid: long equipment walk-throughs without a payoff
